lede.zh: 在 8×A100-80GB、Qwen3-32B BF16 上，以逐请求双门 SLO 达标率比较多副本聚合与 Prefill / Decode 分离。结果显示：并发 128 以下聚合更稳，160 以上 PD 分离反超；结论绑定 16 s TTFT / 60 ms TPOT 判据。
lede.en: On 8× A100-80GB with Qwen3-32B BF16, this report compares aggregated replicas with Prefill/Decode disaggregation using a per-request dual-gate SLO pass rate. Aggregation is stronger through C128; PD disaggregation leads at C160 and above under the tested 16 s TTFT / 60 ms TPOT limits.

snapshot.zh: 双门 SLO 达标率 · 3 次中位数 · 静态 P/D 配比
snapshot.en: Dual-gate SLO pass rate · median of 3 · fixed P/D ratios

heading.zh: 负载门槛决定架构收益
heading.en: Load level determines which layout performs better

intro.zh: 在较低并发，聚合服务用更多实例承担 Prefill，双门 SLO 达标率更高；高并发时共置 Prefill 对 Decode 的干扰使 TPOT 越线，PD 分离隔离 Decode 后更能守住 SLO。
intro.en: At lower concurrency, aggregated serving has more instances available for Prefill and achieves a higher dual-gate SLO pass rate. At high load, colocated Prefill interferes with Decode and pushes TPOT beyond the limit; PD separation protects Decode and preserves more SLO-compliant requests.

note.zh: 这是 SLO-goodput 研究，不是裸吞吐峰值比较。Crossover 位于离散测点之间；结论只适用于当前模型、硬件、软件版本、流量长度和 16 s / 60 ms SLO。
note.en: This is an SLO-goodput study, not a raw-throughput peak comparison. The crossover lies between measured concurrency points; conclusions apply only to the tested model, hardware, software, request lengths, and 16 s / 60 ms SLO.

heading.zh: 高并发时 PD 分离守住 SLO，低于 crossover 时多副本更好
heading.en: PD disaggregation preserves SLOs at high load; replicas win below the crossover

intro.zh: 8×A100 上比较 4 个 TP2 聚合副本与 2P2D 分离部署。纵轴是逐请求同时满足 TTFT ≤16 s、TPOT ≤60 ms 的比例；每档三次运行取中位数。
intro.en: On 8× A100, four TP2 aggregated replicas are compared with a 2P2D disaggregated layout. The metric is the share of requests meeting both TTFT ≤16 s and TPOT ≤60 ms; each concurrency point is the median of three runs.

hint.en: Only C96/C128/C160/C192 were measured; the crossover is between C128 and C160.

notes.zh: C128 两种部署均为 61% 左右，但 C160 时 PD 为 70%、聚合为 32%；C192 时聚合仅 1%，PD 为 69%。因此 crossover 是基于离散测点的区间判断，不是精确阈值。
notes.en: At C128 both layouts are near 60%, but at C160 PD reaches 70% versus 32% for aggregation; at C192 aggregation falls to 1% while PD remains at 69%. The crossover is an interval inferred from discrete points, not an exact threshold.

heading.zh: 2P2D 是本次固定配比扫描中最均衡的方案
heading.en: 2P2D is the most balanced option in this fixed-ratio sweep

intro.zh: 在 C160 下分别扫描同构 2P2D、3P1D，以及 TP1 prefill + TP2 decode 的异构配置。
intro.en: At C160, the study sweeps homogeneous 2P2D and 3P1D layouts plus a heterogeneous TP1-prefill/TP2-decode layout.

title.en: Dual-gate SLO pass rate at C160

hint.zh: 3P1D 的单个 decode 实例成为瓶颈；TP1 prefill 在该模型上 TTFT 过慢。
hint.en: One decode instance bottlenecks 3P1D; TP1 prefill is too slow for this model.

notes.zh: 结论限定于 8×A100、Qwen3-32B TP2 和本次静态配比；动态调度、更大模型和其他 SLO 未测试。
notes.en: This result is limited to 8× A100, Qwen3-32B TP2, and the tested static ratios; dynamic scheduling, larger models, and other SLOs were not tested.

meta.value: 8 × A100 · 4 aggregated TP2 replicas vs 2P2D TP2

methodIntro.zh: 每个并发档清理并验证设备空闲后运行三次；结果使用逐请求是否同时满足 TTFT、TPOT 双门槛的比例。测试档为 C96/128/160/192。
methodIntro.en: Each concurrency run was preceded by a clean-device check and repeated three times. The result is the share of requests meeting both TTFT and TPOT thresholds. Tested points were C96/128/160/192

methodNotes.zh: 低并发端到端时延和原始 token 吞吐未用于本报告的主结论。SLO 改变时，架构 crossover 也可能改变。
methodNotes.en: Low-load end-to-end latency and raw token throughput are not the primary claims here. Changing the SLO can change the architecture crossover.
